{{Quote|Yes, sir, Admiral Zaarin.|Raveen, upon receiving orders from Zaarin|<ref name="Star Wars: TIE Fighter" />}}
'''Raveen''' was a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and then the [[Zaarin coup forces|splinter government]] [[Zaarin's fleet|fleet]] of rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]]. Following the [[destruction of ZA-13]], he was commanded by the Grand Admiral to take their forces to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] for further strikes on the industrial facilities of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
Raveen first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter: Defender of the Empire]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']], released in [[1994]].<ref name="LEC profile">{{LucasArts|url=20th/profiles_larry.htm|text=LucasArts 20th Anniversary Profile: Larry Holland}}</ref> Raveen's appearance in TIE Fighter is actually an edited image of [[Don Henderson]] as [[Cassio Tagge/Legends|Cassio Tagge]] from [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>
